Anchor SmashBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 240% ATK DMG to a single enemy. For every 1 layer of attribute debuff owned by the target, increases this ATK DMG by 10%, up to 50%.
Spinal Anchor Lv.3For every 1 layer of debuff owned by the target, increases the DMG bonus effect of Anchor Smash and Anchor Combo to 15%, up to 75% DMG can be increased.
Anchor ComboActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of 225% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. For every 1 layer of debuff owned by the target, increases this ATK DMG by 10%, up to 50%.
Spinal Anchor Lv.1Anchor Combo: Reduces the target's Turn Meter by 20% after dealing DMG. For every 1 layer of attribute debuff owned by the target, additionally reduces the Turn Meter by 4%, up to 20%.
Spinal Anchor Lv.3For every 1 layer of debuff owned by the target, increases the DMG bonus effect of Anchor Smash and Anchor Combo to 15%, up to 75% DMG can be increased.
